plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-local
plugins.title: Delorun local integration
plugins.sentence: Delorun's own defaults for privacy, devices and permissions.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-instruction-consent
plugins.title: Instruction consent
plugins.sentence: Shows you the change and asks first when the agent's file tools write a skill, a Delorun setup file or an AGENTS.md file

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-mcp-consent
plugins.title: MCP server consent
plugins.sentence: Asks you before a new MCP server command can start, and remembers the ones you accepted

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-permission-defaults
plugins.title: Permission defaults
plugins.sentence: Gives each new workspace the safer permission level, asks once before a workspace gets full access, and sets what its commands can reach on the network

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-schedule-consent
plugins.title: Schedule consent
plugins.sentence: Tells you what a scheduled task will do when you approve it, and checks each run against the permission level you approved

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-fetch-guard
plugins.title: Fetch guard
plugins.sentence: Stops the agent's web fetch tool from reaching addresses on your own computer or private network, and says why when it refuses

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-tool-failure-guard
plugins.title: Tool failure guard
plugins.sentence: Stops a turn that keeps hitting failing tool calls and says so in the chat, so a missing or broken tool does not use up tokens. Send a message to carry on.

plugins.name: @delorun/skill-plugin-authoring
plugins.title: Plugin authoring skill
plugins.sentence: Teaches the agent how to make or change a Delorun plugin in your workspace, and leaves turning it on to you

plugins.name: @delorun/skill-report-problem
plugins.title: Report a problem skill
plugins.sentence: Helps you write up a problem as a GitHub issue that you read and send yourself

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-delegation-consent
plugins.title: Delegation consent
plugins.sentence: Asks you before Claude Code, Codex or another outside agent starts work for you, remembers your answer for each workspace and limits how long a run can last

plugins.name: @delorun/external-agents
plugins.title: External agents gate
plugins.sentence: Starts Claude Code or Codex for a chat only through one checked path, with a limit on live programs, and refuses a start once a plan limit is reached

plugins.name: @delorun/agent-claude-code
plugins.title: Claude Code driver
plugins.sentence: Opens, steers and stops the Claude Code program as a live agent and relays its permission questions to you; it does nothing until the Claude Code pack is added

plugins.name: @delorun/agent-codex
plugins.title: Codex driver
plugins.sentence: Opens, steers and stops the Codex program as a live agent and relays its approval questions to you; it does nothing until the Codex pack is added

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-agent-seats
plugins.title: Live agents
plugins.sentence: Shows Claude Code and Codex as chats under the chat that handed work over, which you can watch, message and stop; it adds nothing unless the live agents preview flag is on

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-multiview
plugins.title: Multiview
plugins.sentence: Watch several agents beside the main chat, pin the ones you follow and arrange them as you like

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-changes
plugins.title: Changes
plugins.sentence: Nothing changes what Delorun runs until you approve it at your computer; the Changes section in Settings reviews, applies, discards and undoes changes, and loads a plugin's edits live while you work on it

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-update
plugins.title: Updates
plugins.sentence: Update Delorun from the studio: check for a newer release, read what it would change, update, and go back, without a terminal

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-packs
plugins.title: Plugin packs
plugins.sentence: Downloads an optional plugin pack when you turn it on and checks it against the signed list of packs before it loads

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-install-check
plugins.title: Install check
plugins.sentence: Warns about plugins with no integrity check, known security problems, very new versions or names that look like another plugin, and tells you when an installed plugin has changed

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-trash
plugins.title: Trash
plugins.sentence: Deleting a chat or a workspace moves it to the trash for 30 days; the Trash section in Settings restores it or deletes it forever

plugins.name: @delorun/home-auth
plugins.title: Device sign-in
plugins.sentence: Approves each phone or computer that connects, once, at your computer, and lists the devices you have approved

plugins.name: @delorun/reach
plugins.title: Reach
plugins.sentence: Lets you open Delorun from your phone or another computer over your own Tailscale network, once you turn it on

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-theme
plugins.title: Delorun theme
plugins.sentence: Delorun's look in the studio: the Soft palette, the accent, Delorun's typefaces, the Appearance and Conversation settings, and one switch back to the stock look

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-settings-layout
plugins.title: Delorun settings layout
plugins.sentence: Settings grouped by topic, with search and a larger panel. Turn it off, or choose the stock look, for upstream's flat list.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-chat-states
plugins.title: Chat states
plugins.sentence: Snooze chats or mark them settled, with Snoozed and Settled shelves in the sidebar

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-sidebar
plugins.title: Delorun sidebar
plugins.sentence: Chats as cards with Working, Snoozed and Settled shelves, search and a workspace filter. Choose the stock look under Settings → General → Look for the stock list.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-onboarding
plugins.title: Delorun onboarding
plugins.sentence: The first-run guide: language, model keys, look, agents, recommended plugins, phone access and a workspace, ending in a new chat. Settings → General → Getting started shows it again.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-new-workspace
plugins.title: New workspace
plugins.sentence: One guided dialog to start a workspace from a new folder, a folder on this computer or a Git repository, with the places you used last close at hand.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-downloads
plugins.title: Downloads panel
plugins.sentence: Shows the plugins being installed, with their progress and place in the queue.

plugins.name: @delorun/preview-flags
plugins.title: Preview flags
plugins.sentence: Lets a plugin mark a studio feature as not ready for everyone, with one setting that turns it on

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-cost-meter
plugins.title: Cost meter
plugins.sentence: Shows the chat's estimated cost under the composer, including its subagents and teammates, with a breakdown by agent, model and token type.

plugins.name: @delorun/plugin-thinking-rsvp
plugins.title: Thinking tab
plugins.sentence: Read the model’s reasoning and reply word by word in the right sidebar as it writes them.

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-agent-hooks
plugins.title: Claude Code and Codex hooks
plugins.sentence: Runs the hooks from your Claude Code settings and your Codex hooks file at the same points in a Delorun turn, and loads Claude Code mods

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-browser
plugins.title: Browser
plugins.sentence: Lets the agent open pages, click and read in a Chromium browser on this computer, through Playwright

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-code-intelligence
plugins.title: Code intelligence
plugins.sentence: Lets the agent ask a language server for definitions, references and hover information. Needs typescript-language-server on your PATH

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-computer-use-driver
plugins.title: Computer use (Cua Driver)
plugins.sentence: Lets the agent see and operate desktop windows on Linux and Windows through the Cua Driver SDK. macOS has Computer use

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-external-agents
plugins.title: External agents
plugins.sentence: Lets the agent hand a task to the Codex or Claude Code program you already have installed, and runs Python code in tool programs

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-real-browser
plugins.title: Your own browser
plugins.sentence: In a chat where you allow it, the agent works in your own Chrome, signed in as you, through browse
requires: your own browser paired with it

plugins.name: @delorun/bundle-webhooks
plugins.title: Webhooks
plugins.sentence: Starts a chat when a signed GitHub webhook arrives. Needs a secret in DELORUN_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET and a rule of your own
